confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use recent Milan price-index estimates. Cocktail uses a current city cost-of-living estimate; wine is estimated relative to local draft-beer prices. Accommodation is a broad model estimate without live lodging research, so it is less certain and varies with season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink estimates are based on Milan data, and lodging is estimated from general knowledge of a major northern Italian business and tourism city.
